description: Points one subdomain of the customer's domain (for example ai.example.com, passed as the host parameter) at AEO Action's hosting on Vercel with a single CNAME record, so the pages the customer approves are served on their own domain. Nothing else in the zone is touched.
variableDescription: %target%: the CNAME target Vercel recommends for this hostname (cname.vercel-dns.com or a per-project <id>.vercel-dns-NNN.com name). The service checks it against *.vercel-dns(-NNN).com before signing.
